title: Ledger Event
description: One append-only line in a run's hash-chained ledger (runs/<id>/ledger.jsonl). Tamper-evident: hash = chain_hash(prev_hash, {seq,ts,event_type,payload}). The first event has prev_hash=null.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp supplied by the caller (deterministic, never auto-now in tests)

event_type.description: boundary = clean checkpoint (resumable); stage_started without a following boundary = crashed mid-stage; task_frame_pinned anchors the run's north-star/task_frame sha256 into the chain (audit H2.3 — the direction contract is tamper-evident too)

prev_hash.description: hash of the previous event; null for seq 0
